# Experiment 7 & 8 results (generated by experiments/summarize.py)

Workload (identical for every run): 15000 POST /predict requests built from real IMD 2024 windows, 20 concurrent clients, 100 warm-up requests, fixed seed. Values are mean ± std over 3 repeats. Containers with Docker CPU/memory limits on an Apple M2 laptop (Docker Desktop VM: 8 CPUs, 3.8 GiB) emulate cloud instance sizes.

**Costs are ESTIMATES, not actual charges**: AWS Fargate on-demand Linux/ARM, ap-south-1 (Mumbai): USD 0.02383 per vCPU-hour + USD 0.00261 per GB-hour (AWS public price list, published 2026-09-11). Cost per 1M predictions = hourly cost / (throughput × 3600) × 10^6.

## Experiment 7: right-sizing

| Config | CPU peak % of 1 core | CPU used % of limit | Mem peak MiB | Mem used % of limit | Throughput req/s | p50 ms | p95 ms | Errors | Est. USD/hour | Est. USD per 1M predictions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| over-provisioned (2.0 vCPU, 2g) | 55.1 ± 2.5 | 27.5 ± 1.2 | 105.1 ± 0.5 | 5.1 ± 0.1 | 661.3 ± 19.9 | 15.0 ± 0.3 | 97.9 ± 3.0 | 0 | 0.0529 | 0.0222 |
| right-sized (0.75 vCPU, 192m) | 47.0 ± 1.7 | 62.6 ± 2.3 | 115.5 ± 0.8 | 60.1 ± 0.4 | 590.5 ± 12.4 | 16.5 ± 0.4 | 108.6 ± 2.0 | 0 | 0.0184 | 0.0086 |


Change after right-sizing: throughput -10.7%, p50 10.0%, p95 10.9%, hourly cost -65.2%, cost per 1M predictions -61.3%.

## Experiment 8: instance-size comparison

Target (fixed before running): p95 ≤ 150 ms, errors ≤ 0, no OOM kill.

| Config | CPU peak % of 1 core | CPU used % of limit | Mem peak MiB | Mem used % of limit | Throughput req/s | p50 ms | p95 ms | Errors | Est. USD/hour | Est. USD per 1M predictions | Meets target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| low (0.25 vCPU, 512m) | 25.9 ± 0.5 | 103.4 ± 1.8 | 118.2 ± 0.7 | 23.1 ± 0.1 | 316.2 ± 5.1 | 54.8 ± 3.2 | 112.0 ± 0.7 | 0 | 0.0073 | 0.0064 | yes |
| medium (0.5 vCPU, 1g) | 42.5 ± 1.9 | 85.0 ± 3.8 | 106.0 ± 0.5 | 10.3 ± 0.1 | 580.1 ± 35.9 | 16.7 ± 1.1 | 108.9 ± 6.7 | 0 | 0.0145 | 0.0070 | yes |
| high (1.0 vCPU, 2g) | 52.9 ± 1.1 | 52.9 ± 1.1 | 105.7 ± 0.4 | 5.2 ± 0.1 | 603.2 ± 8.1 | 16.0 ± 0.1 | 107.3 ± 2.5 | 0 | 0.0290 | 0.0134 | yes |


**Most cost-efficient config meeting the target: low** (USD 0.0064 per 1M predictions).


Sensitivity (post-hoc, not the pre-defined target): if the target also required ≥ 500 req/s, the choice would be **medium**.
